comments.author: Dan Abrams
comments.text:
When a bead exceeds stuck_bead_threshold, it's skipped but never closed or deprioritized. beads.Ready() returns the same stuck bead on the next iteration, creating an infinite loop of 'Skipped after N failures' logs with duplicate comments added each time. Loops until maxIterations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Stuck beads are skipped exactly once per run, not re-fetched
- If all ready beads are stuck, loop exits with clear message
- No duplicate comments added to stuck beads

```bash
ralph triage              # Interactive triage session

> Create a simple web UI that shows ralph run history and current status

Priority? [0/1/2, default=1]: 2

Any dependencies? (bead IDs, comma-separated, or skip):

title: Ensure trailing newline after heartbeat overwrite before next log output
description:
In internal/runner/runner.go, the overwriteHeartbeat function (line 712) writes with fmt.Fprintf(r.output, "\r%s%s", newLine, padding) - no trailing newline. The heartbeat goroutine runs concurrently with Claude's streaming output (both writing to r.output), which can also cause interleaved output.

Fix: When stopHeartbeat() is called (heartbeat goroutine exits), ensure the output has a trailing newline if the last heartbeat used overwrite mode. Consider adding synchronization or ensuring a newline is written when the heartbeat goroutine is shutting down.

2. No visual artifacts from overwritten heartbeat lines remain in output

- Keep 30s timer as fallback for quiet periods

3. 30s fallback timer still works during quiet periods

title: Add precheck config to non-precheck runner tests to prevent accidental precheck execution
description: Runner tests that don't specifically test precheck (e.g. TestRunWithMocks_SkipsStuckBeads, TestRunWithMocks_ClosesBeadOnSuccess at interfaces_test.go) don't set Precheck config. Since NewRunnerWithDeps doesn't call setDefaults(), precheck is disabled by default (nil Enabled pointer → IsEnabled() returns true, but empty Model means Claude.Run gets empty model string). This works accidentally but could break if defaults change. Consider either: (1) having NewRunnerWithDeps call setDefaults(), or (2) explicitly disabling precheck in tests that don't test it.
